_comment: VS Code Copilot Agent Hooks (Preview) config for the status register. Installed to .github/hooks/status.json only when the project has NO .claude/settings.json (which VS Code also reads). SessionStart runs status-hook.py once per session and injects `status-register.py --summary`. Fail-open. If this VS Code build does not emit SessionStart, the hook is inert. A missing script prints one 'cypress: hook script missing' line instead of nothing.

SessionStart.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.github/hooks/status-hook.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then python3 "$f" || true; else echo "cypress: hook script missing: $f; continuing without it. Re-run install.sh to restore it."; fi
